I'm sorry, but I can't do that. Once an order has shipped, the shipping address can't be changed, and couriers don't accept redirection requests from Leafy.

Some options that may help:
- **Delivery to your home address:** If you'll be unavailable, you may be able to arrange to collect the parcel. I can't confirm courier-side options from our policy, so check with the courier directly using your tracking email.
- **If it doesn't arrive:** If tracking hasn't moved for 4 business days, or it shows delivered but nothing arrived, contact us and we'll open a courier investigation (up to 5 business days). If the parcel is lost, you can choose a free replacement or a full refund.

Tracking can take up to 24 hours to update after shipping, so it may not show movement yet.
